actions.description: Checks source disk size and available destination space. Run this before virtualize_for_migration to prevent filling the disk.
Changes the IP address on a network interface. Supports IPv4, IPv6, static, and DHCP modes.
safety_notes: Changing IP may temporarily disconnect the agent from the control plane

actions.description: Configures rsyslog/syslog-ng (Linux) or NXLog/WEF (Windows) to forward logs to a remote collector.
Creates a disk image of the machine and pre-configures the target IP inside the image. Run estimate_image_size first.
safety_notes: Run estimate_image_size first to verify sufficient disk space

actions.description: Uploads a disk image to S3 (or compatible object storage) using multipart upload.
Applies CIS/STIG PAM policies: password complexity, account lockout, session timeout. Supports pam_pwquality and pam_faillock (modern) or pam_cracklib and pam_tally2 (legacy).
safety_notes: Misconfigured PAM can lock out all users including root - test in non-production first
lockout_duration_seconds applies to all accounts; ensure break-glass access exists

actions.description: Writes /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-nexplane-hardening.conf with secure defaults: no root login, key-only auth, cipher/MAC allowlist, idle timeout. Validates with sshd -t before reloading.
safety_notes: Disabling password_authentication requires key-based auth to be working first
Changing SSH port requires updating external firewall rules before reloading

actions.description: Read-only audit: surfaces accounts with no password expiry, UID 0 non-root accounts, service accounts with interactive shells, empty passwords, and sudo group members.

Detection-only check for known Linux LPE conditions: PwnKit (CVE-2021-4034), DirtyPipe (CVE-2022-0847), Dirty COW (CVE-2016-5195), unexpected SUID binaries, writable cron/service files, misconfigured sudo rules.
Installs or removes CA certificates in the OS trust store. Detects Debian (update-ca-certificates) vs RHEL (update-ca-trust extract). Validates PEM before installing.
safety_notes: Installing an untrusted CA certificate compromises TLS security for all processes on this host

actions.description: Configures NTP servers via chrony, systemd-timesyncd, or ntpd (auto-detected). Critical for audit log timestamp integrity. Supports iburst and chrony makestep.
safety_notes: NTP misconfiguration causes clock drift which invalidates audit log timestamps

actions.description: Set SELinux mode (enforcing/permissive/disabled), install policy modules, or generate policy from audit log denials.
Load AppArmor profiles and set enforce/complain/disable mode.
Apply a seccomp filter profile to a systemd service via drop-in override.
Apply CIS-level sysctl parameters: disable IP forwarding, enable SYN cookies, disable ICMP redirects, enable source route validation. Writes /etc/sysctl.d/99-nexplane-hardening.conf.
Add or remove iptables/nftables/firewalld rules on the host. Auto-detects firewall tool.
safety_notes: Incorrect firewall rules can lock out remote management access

actions.description: Prevent loading of specified kernel modules via /etc/modprobe.d/nexplane-blacklist.conf.
Apply noexec/nosuid/nodev to /tmp, /dev/shm, /var/tmp via /etc/fstab. Remounts affected filesystems.
Install CIS Level 1/2 or custom auditd rule sets to /etc/audit/rules.d/. Reloads auditd.
Initialize AIDE or Tripwire baseline database (init), or run a check against the baseline (check).
Read-only: reports current SELinux mode, AppArmor profiles, auditd status, and recent MAC denials.
Load and attach a compiled eBPF program to a kernel hook (kprobe, tracepoint, tc, xdp, cgroup, lsm).
safety_notes: Requires kernel 5.8+ and CAP_BPF capability

actions.description: Apply a declarative security policy via an installed eBPF framework (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon, bpfd).
Read-only: lists all loaded eBPF programs and network attachments. Flags programs not deployed by Nexplane.
Enable or disable Local Administrator Password Solution to randomize local admin passwords.
Enable VBS-based Credential Guard to protect credential material in LSASS. Requires reboot.
safety_notes: Requires reboot to take effect
UEFI lock prevents registry rollback

actions.description: Enforce PowerShell Constrained Language Mode via registry key.
Deploy AppLocker application allowlist policies. Defaults to AuditOnly mode before enforcing.
safety_notes: Test in AuditOnly mode before enforcing

actions.description: Disable SMBv1, require signing, disable guest access.
Enable BitLocker full disk encryption. Recovery key returned in result - store securely.
safety_notes: Save the recovery key - it cannot be recovered later
Rollback after encryption requires full decryption

actions.description: Add/remove firewall rules or set default inbound/outbound actions.
safety_notes: Setting default inbound=Block without an allow rule for RDP/WinRM will lock out remote management

actions.description: Disable SSL/TLS 1.0/1.1, enforce TLS 1.2/1.3 via SCHANNEL registry. Requires reboot.
safety_notes: Requires reboot to take effect
Disabling TLS 1.0/1.1 breaks legacy .NET clients

actions.description: Require NLA, set encryption level, configure idle/disconnect timeout.
Apply CIS/STIG auditpol settings for logon, object access, privilege use, process creation.
Read-only: enumerate all scheduled tasks, flag privileged, hidden, unregistered, and writable-binary tasks.
Apply CIS registry hardening: disable autorun, LM hash, NTLMv1, WDigest; enforce UAC; enable safe DLL search.
safety_notes: disable_ntlmv1 breaks auth to legacy systems that only support NTLMv1

actions.description: Deploy, renew, or validate TLS certificates. Supports ACME (Let's Encrypt), internal CA, and manual PEM upload. Linux: nginx/apache. Windows: IIS.
Configure DNS resolvers on Linux (resolv.conf/systemd-resolved) or Windows. Supports plain, DoH, and DoT.
Read-only: enumerate installed packages with versions. Linux: dpkg/rpm. Windows: registry uninstall keys.
CIS Control 2: enumerate all installed packages with name, version, and package manager. Linux: dpkg/rpm/apk/snap. Windows: registry uninstall keys. Capped at 1000 packages.
In-place kernel/package upgrade with cloud or dd snapshot rollback, or containerize-and-migrate path for major OS version upgrades.
safety_notes: Always take a cloud snapshot before running
dd-based rollback requires booting from rescue media
dist upgrade is potentially destructive - test on non-production first

actions.description: Apply security patches on a Linux host using apt, dnf, or yum. Supports security-only mode, specific package, or CVE-targeted patching. Captures before/after versions and detects reboot requirement.
safety_notes: Use dry_run=true first to preview changes
Reboot may be required after applying kernel or glibc patches

actions.description: Read-only: returns installed packages, available security updates, days since last security patch, and reboot-required status.
Install Windows Updates using the Windows Update Agent COM API. Supports security-only mode or a specific KB article. Schedules reboot via Task Scheduler if required.
safety_notes: Use dry_run=true first to preview pending updates
Reboot is often required; use defer_reboot=true to prevent automatic scheduling
Rollback uninstalls the KB - not all KBs support uninstallation

actions.description: Read-only: returns installed KBs, pending security updates with severity and CVE IDs, last update check time, and reboot-pending status.

Evaluates all assets against a patch age threshold. Flags hosts whose last_security_patch_at metadata is older than max_patch_age_days. Optionally creates patch_packages change requests for non-compliant hosts.
Fan out patching across all hosts affected by a CVE or vulnerable package version. Patches in rolling batches and aborts if the failure rate exceeds the configured threshold.
safety_notes: Use dry_run=true to preview affected hosts before executing
Set abort_error_threshold conservatively (0.1-0.2) for production fleets
Ensure agents are reachable and not mid-reboot before starting a campaign

actions.description: Discover applications running on the host (systemd services, listening ports, non-package binaries)
Generate Dockerfile + k8s manifests, build container image, push to registry
Full autonomous containerization pipeline: discovery, AI analysis, build, deploy, soak verify, and retirement CR spawn
Stop and disable the legacy systemd service after containerization
Multi-stage IP migration with method-aware dispatch (Tailscale, secondary swap, commit timer, or manual), DNS record discovery, and per-stage rollback.
safety_notes: Changing IP may temporarily disconnect the agent from the control plane
Use method=tailscale if Tailscale is deployed to eliminate connectivity risk
DNS records are discovered automatically but v1 DNS update is not yet automated

actions.description: Apply security patches to a Linux or Windows host. Dispatches apply_linux_patches or apply_windows_patches based on OS family. Updates last_security_patch_at metadata on success.
safety_notes: Use dry_run=true first to preview changes
Reboot may be required after applying kernel or glibc patches

actions.description: Read-only: runs audit_patch_status agent command to return installed packages, available security updates, and reboot-required status.
Verifies a patch was applied by checking the installed package version against an expected minimum version. Returns verified=true if the package meets the expected version.
Check disk space, list running services, and verify no active connections before a major OS upgrade.
Take a VM snapshot (EBS or equivalent) before executing the OS upgrade, for rollback on failure.
safety_notes: Skipping the snapshot removes the ability to auto-rollback after a failed upgrade

actions.description: Run do-release-upgrade (Ubuntu) or leapp (RHEL/CentOS) to upgrade the host to the next major OS release. Causes downtime.
safety_notes: This operation causes extended downtime (30-120 minutes typical)
Ensure a pre-upgrade snapshot exists before running
Config file migrations may require manual review after upgrade

actions.description: Confirm the new OS version is running and all previously-running services have come back up after the upgrade.
Fleet-level IP migration. Applies change_ip across a set of assets in configurable batches. Aborts if the error rate exceeds the threshold.
safety_notes: Use dry_run=true to preview the migration plan before executing
Set abort_error_threshold conservatively (0.05-0.1) for production fleets
Completed batches are not automatically rolled back — operator initiates per-host recovery
